name: 10ft SEG Backlit Fabric Display
descriptionHtml:
Download Template

This illuminated large format trade show display is suitable for all large-scale marketing purposes. Radiant and eye-catching with its bright illumination, this display is perfectly suited for attracting the attention of a wide amount of customers and clientele.

SEG displays utilize a silicone edge graphic (SEG) to create a seamless and visually appealing presentation. It is commonly used in the field of visual marketing and trade shows. The silicone strip is designed to fit into a channel on the display frame. This creates a taut and smooth appearance without any visible seams on the front surface of the display. Changing out SEG graphics is a breeze.

Interior LED lighting enhances the backlit fabric prints making these displays true show-stoppers.

Features:

  • High resolution UV printed
  • UV safe that will last for years
  • Blackout Fabric included for Single Sided option

Material:

  • 6 oz. Premium Backlit Fabric
  • Aluminum Frame

Size and Weight:

  • Display Size: 118.1"W x 88.6"H x 17"D
  • Weight: 31 lbs (each box, 2 boxes total)
  • Package Size: 57"W x 13.5"H x 7.5"D (box1) and 48.5"W x 13.5"H x 7.5"D (box2)
